title: Speed, velocity and displacement
log: 2026-11-20T12:15:23Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: No bank point teaches the distance versus displacement distinction and average velocity as change in displacement over time at Stage 5 depth; the closest card, phys-displacement-velocity-acceleration, is written for Year 11 Physics and also covers acceleration, so it is not a small adaptation.

draft.title: Speed, velocity and displacement
card: how far an object travels along its path. It has a size only, with no direction.
how far an object ends up from where it started, in a straight line, in a stated direction. It can be smaller than the distance travelled.
distance travelled ÷ time taken. Average velocity = change in displacement ÷ time taken, and it has a direction.
Speed and velocity are measured in metres per second (m/s). If an object returns to its start, its displacement is zero, so its average velocity is zero.
draft.remember: Distance and speed have no direction. Displacement and velocity do.

a.q: Priya walks 60 m east along a path, then 20 m back west. What is her displacement from the start?
a.why: Displacement is the straight-line change from the start, in a direction. She ends 60 - 20 = 40 m east of the start. Adding the two parts gives 80 m, which is the distance, not the displacement.
a.clue: Subtract the walk back from the walk out.

b.q: A cyclist in Wagga Wagga rides 3 km north in 10 minutes, then rides 3 km back to the start in 10 minutes. Which statement is correct for the whole trip?
opts: Average velocity is zero, average speed is not
Average speed is zero, average velocity is not
Both average speed and average velocity are zero
Neither average speed nor average velocity is zero
b.why: The cyclist ends where she began, so displacement is zero and average velocity is zero. She still travelled 6 km in 20 minutes, so her average speed is not zero. Average speed uses distance, which never cancels out.
b.clue: Where does the cyclist finish compared with the start?

b.best: Average velocity is zero, average speed is not
